2irBI1-wUSwavFrgqpj5_g.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於9/17-23期間,WPV1 新增阿富汗7例;cVDPV2新增2國共4例,分別為剛果⺠主共和國3例、查德1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1件 。 巴基斯坦9/29報告新增1例WPV1病例,為17個月大的女嬰,居住於西北部開伯爾-普赫圖赫瓦省(KP)班努地區。此案為該國今年第5例病例,其中4例在班努地區發現,該國今年已啟動4次大規模疫苗接種運動。
2irBI1-wUSwavFrgqpj5_g.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 17–23 September, WPV1 added 7 cases in Afghanistan; cVDPV2 added 4 cases in 2 countries, 3 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and 1 in Chad; and in environmental samples, WPV1 added 1 detection in Pakistan. On 29 September, Pakistan reported one new WPV1 case, a 17-month-old girl living in Bannu district of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP) province in the north-west. This is the country's fifth case this year, 4 of which were found in Bannu district. The country has launched four mass vaccination campaigns this year.

iTifhSV3YPdPp3P4VQcmgg.zh: 非洲地區疫情持續,WHO今年9/16發佈風險評估報告,該地區風險評估為中等(Moderate)、全球風險低(Low)。今年截至8月下旬,該洲共8國出現疫情,累計逾1.5萬例疑病例,以奈及利亞12,155例疑病例、225例死亡為主,其次為查德(1,251例疑病例、5例死亡)、日(818例疑病例、27例死亡)及幾內亞(600例確定病例、49例死亡)等。疫苗覆蓋率下降、低實驗室確診率、即時治療(抗生素及白喉抗毒素)的不穩定性,人群跨境移動等因素阻礙疫情控制。
iTifhSV3YPdPp3P4VQcmgg.en: Diphtheria activity continues in Africa. WHO issued a risk assessment on 16 September: the regional risk is assessed as moderate and the global risk as low. As of late August this year, eight countries in the region have reported outbreaks, with more than 15,000 cumulative suspected cases, mainly Nigeria with 12,155 suspected cases and 225 deaths, followed by Chad (1,251 suspected cases, 5 deaths), Niger (818 suspected cases, 27 deaths) and Guinea (600 confirmed cases, 49 deaths). Declining vaccine coverage, low laboratory confirmation rates, unstable access to immediate treatment (antibiotics and diphtheria antitoxin) and cross-border population movement are hindering outbreak control.

U6KDJdnwBzrqnJZbLUeMvg.zh: WHO於今年5/14召開第45次IHR小兒麻痺症緊急委員會並於8/25公布決議,今年截至4/30全球累積報告16例WPV1病例、2 例cVDPV1病例、28例cVDPV2病例及2例cVDPV3病例。環境樣本部分:累計報告74件WPV1、27件cVDPV2。考量全球疫情傳播及疫苗覆蓋率,評估持續構成國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC),並再延⻑臨時性措施3個月,惟不構成緊急大流行(Pandemic Emergency),並建議有11個國家(有WPV1、cVDPV1、cVDPV3傳播風險者)需加強疫情監測及疫苗接種等措施,包括有WPV1疫情之阿富汗、巴基斯坦、德國,有cVDPV1 疫情之阿爾及利亞、剛果⺠主共和國、吉布地、以色列、寮國,有cVDPV3疫情之喀麥隆、查德、奈及利亞;另建議24個有cVDPV2國內傳播風險的國家加強防治措施。由於核疫區的持續傳播、偏鄉與衝突地區疫苗接種覆蓋率不均以及頻繁的跨國人口流動,WPV1及cVDPV仍具有高度國際傳播風險 。 WHO於8/19宣布非洲5國cVDPV2疫情已終止,分別為蒲隆地 、迦納、幾內亞比索、剛果共和國及烏干達。當局近年透過資金與技術支援、加強疫苗接種,強化急性無力肢體麻痺監測與實驗室檢驗能力,以及應用地理資訊系統的成功阻斷疫情。
U6KDJdnwBzrqnJZbLUeMvg.en: WHO convened the 45th IHR Emergency Committee on polio on 14 May this year and published its decision on 25 August. As of 30 April this year, 16 WPV1 cases, 2 cVDPV1 cases, 28 cVDPV2 cases and 2 cVDPV3 cases had been reported worldwide. For environmental samples, 74 WPV1 and 27 cVDPV2 detections had been reported cumulatively. Considering global transmission and vaccination coverage, the committee assessed that polio continues to constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), extended temporary recommendations by 3 months, but does not constitute a Pandemic Emergency. It recommended that 11 countries at risk of WPV1, cVDPV1 or cVDPV3 transmission strengthen surveillance and vaccination: Afghanistan, Pakistan and Germany (WPV1 outbreaks); Algeria, the DRC, Djibouti, Israel and Laos (cVDPV1 outbreaks); and Cameroon, Chad and Nigeria (cVDPV3 outbreaks). It also recommended that 24 countries at risk of domestic cVDPV2 transmission strengthen control measures. Owing to continued transmission in endemic areas, uneven vaccination coverage in remote and conflict-affected areas, and frequent cross-border population movement, WPV1 and cVDPV remain at high risk of international spread. WHO declared on 19 August that cVDPV2 outbreaks had ended in five African countries: Burundi, Ghana, Guinea-Bissau, the Republic of the Congo and Uganda. In recent years, these outbreaks were stopped through financial and technical support, enhanced vaccination, strengthened acute flaccid paralysis surveillance and laboratory capacity, and the use of geographic information systems.

KDRlz3r4l1zdeaPiasgEbw.zh: 非洲區自2025年初迄今年3/1,阿爾及利亞、查德、幾內亞、馬利、茅利塔亞、日、奈及利亞和南非8國共通報超過29,000 例疑病例,其中1,420例死亡(CFR:4.9%),其中 752例經實驗確定病例,主要集中於日(313例)、奈及利亞(211例)及南非(93例)。WHO評估疫情有進一步地理擴散的潛力、致死率偏高、控制疫情的資源(疫苗與DAT)嚴重不足、且監測與實驗室系統受限, 該區傳播風險為中,全球風險為低。 奈及利亞日(Niger)州疫情呈多點擴散,今年截至8月,累計報告124例確定病例,17例死亡(CFR:13.7%),高於該國同期平均(2.3%),病例主要為未接種疫苗之兒童。因疫苗覆蓋率低,以及跨區人口流動及疫苗猶豫等因素,該國刻正推動逐戶接種疫苗及與宗教領袖合作等措施,以防止疫情擴散。 塞內加爾今年5至8月進行病歷回溯調查(醫療機構病歷),有591 例曾出現喉嚨痛、扁桃腺炎等症狀,其中7例為確定病例,主要集中於東部凱杜古(Kedougou)及薩拉亞(Saraya)地區,該國已於受影響區加強疫苗補接種與主動監測,以防止疫情向周邊擴散。
KDRlz3r4l1zdeaPiasgEbw.en: From early 2025 to 1 March this year, eight countries in the African Region (Algeria, Chad, Guinea, Mali, Mauritania, Niger, Nigeria and South Africa) reported more than 29,000 suspected cases, of which 1,420 died (CFR 4.9%). 752 cases were laboratory-confirmed, mainly in Niger (313), Nigeria (211) and South Africa (93). WHO assesses that the outbreak has potential for further geographic spread and a high case fatality rate, that control resources (vaccines and diphtheria antitoxin, DAT) are severely insufficient, and that surveillance and laboratory systems are limited; the transmission risk in the region is moderate, and the global risk is low. In Niger State, Nigeria, the outbreak has spread across multiple points: as of August this year, 124 confirmed cases and 17 deaths had been cumulatively reported (CFR 13.7%), higher than the country's average for the same period (2.3%); most cases were unvaccinated children. Owing to low vaccine coverage, cross-regional population movement and vaccine hesitancy, the country is pursuing door-to-door vaccination and cooperation with religious leaders to prevent further spread. In Senegal, a retrospective review of medical records from May to August this year identified 591 cases with symptoms such as sore throat and tonsillitis, of which 7 were confirmed, mainly in the eastern Kédougou and Saraya areas. Senegal has strengthened catch-up vaccination and active surveillance in affected areas to prevent spread to surrounding areas.

y02ozEKU3FeZeldToHWnyA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於7/9-15期間,WPV1新增阿富汗4例;cVDPV1新增2國共3例,分別為衣索比亞2例、南蘇丹1例;cVDPV2新增2國共3例,分別為剛果⺠主共和國2例、查德1例;cVDPV3新增奈及利亞1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增2國共13件,分別為阿富汗12件、巴基斯坦1件,cVDPV1新增馬達加斯加2件。

sSGfCo8Hdi5E4sG8tnhkXg.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於4/23-29期間,cVDPV2新增3國共4例,分別為查德2例、剛果民主共和國/奈及利亞各21例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦6件,cVDPV2新增2國共2件,分別為馬拉威/奈及利亞各1件。 澳洲西部珀斯(Perth)於4月中旬檢出 1 件cVDPV2環境樣本,基因定序與近年於非洲、歐洲及巴布亞紐幾內亞檢出之病毒相近,因當地疫苗覆蓋率達92%,且無社區傳播跡象,當局評估風險為非常低,推測可能為旅外人員將病毒排泄至汙水系統。另該國最近 1 例人類案例係發生於1972年。
sSGfCo8Hdi5E4sG8tnhkXg.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 23 and 29 April, cVDPV2 added four cases across three countries: two in Chad, and 21 each in the DRC and Nigeria. For environmental samples, WPV1 added six specimens in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 added two specimens across two countries, one each in Malawi and Nigeria. In mid-April, one cVDPV2 environmental sample was detected in Perth, Western Australia. Its genetic sequence is similar to viruses detected in recent years in Africa, Europe and Papua New Guinea. Because local vaccination coverage reaches 92% and there are no signs of community transmission, authorities assess the risk as very low and speculate that the virus may have been excreted into the sewage system by someone who travelled abroad. The country's most recent human case occurred in 1972.

ntGQB584jFhG2l4dPlDOjQ.zh: WHO非洲區自去(2025)年截至今年3/1共計8國(阿爾及利亞、查德、幾內亞、馬利、茅利塔亞、日、奈及利亞、南非)累計報告逾2.9萬例疑病例,其中1.8萬例為確定病例,1,420例死亡,752例經實驗室確診,相較WHO於去年10月進行之風險評估,疑病例新增約1.1萬例,死亡人數新增529例,奈及利亞為該區疑及死亡病例最多國家,佔5成以上,病患以5-14歲兒童年齡層及女性為主。WHO考量該區每週新增病例數整體呈下降趨勢且多數國家已啟動應變工作,惟仍有診斷試劑/檢驗/藥物缺乏等問題,評估非洲區整體公共衛生風險由「高」調整為「中」,另非洲區以外多數國家具備完善之免疫計畫與健全之監測系統,全球公共衛生風險為「低」,惟仍須留意至非洲區旅遊之罹病風險。
ntGQB584jFhG2l4dPlDOjQ.en: The WHO African Region reported more than 29,000 suspected cases from last year through 1 March this year across eight countries (Algeria, Chad, Equatorial Guinea, Mauritania, Niger, Nigeria, Mali and South Africa). Of these, 18,000 were classified as confirmed cases, 1,420 died, and 752 were laboratory-confirmed. Compared with the WHO risk assessment conducted in October last year, suspected cases increased by about 11,000 and deaths by 529. Nigeria accounted for more than half of the suspected and fatal cases in the region, and patients were mainly children aged 5–14 years and females. WHO noted that weekly new cases in the region are generally declining and most countries have activated response operations, but shortages of diagnostic tests, laboratory capacity and drugs persist. WHO has therefore revised the overall public health risk for the African Region from 'high' to 'moderate'. Most countries outside Africa have robust immunization programmes and sound surveillance systems, so the global public health risk is assessed as 'low'; however, the risk of disease for travellers to the African Region should still be noted.

aoApAvC_qJ5UJe7J0GYTFg.zh: WHO非洲區今年截至第10週累計報告3,988例疑病例及173例死亡病例,其中日及查德共計2地區達疫情流行閾,中非共和國、日、剛果民主共和國、查德及多哥部分地區達警戒閾。疑病例中,312例經實驗室檢驗病原體,其中包含肺炎鏈球菌(42.9%)、腦膜炎雙球菌C型(38.5%)、腦膜炎雙球菌W型(10.9%)、非b型流感嗜血桿菌(1.3%)等。
aoApAvC_qJ5UJe7J0GYTFg.en: The WHO African Region reported 3,988 suspected cases and 173 deaths as of week 10 this year. Niger and Chad have reached the epidemic threshold, while parts of the Central African Republic, Niger, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Chad and Togo have reached the alert threshold. Of the suspected cases, 312 were tested in the laboratory for pathogens, including Streptococcus pneumoniae (42.9%), Neisseria meningitidis serogroup C (38.5%), Neisseria meningitidis serogroup W (10.9%), non-type b Haemophilus influenzae (1.3%) and others.

bInLbkRMVDE04eWMXcEvBA.zh: WHO非洲區共計8國(阿爾及利亞、查德、幾內亞、馬利、茅利塔亞、日、奈及利亞、南非)累計報告逾2萬例疑病例,其中9,864 例經實驗室確診,1,252例死亡,多數病患為兒童及青少年族群。受限於診斷試劑/檢驗/臨床照護能力不足及白喉抗毒素(DAT)供應短缺等因素,嚴重影響疫情防治工作。WHO考量非洲區疫情可能持續擴散,評估非洲區整體公共衛生風險為高,另非洲區以外多數國家具備完善之免疫計畫與健全之監測系統,全球公共衛生風險為低。
bInLbkRMVDE04eWMXcEvBA.en: Eight countries in the WHO African Region (Algeria, Chad, Guinea, Mali, Mauritania, Niger, Nigeria and South Africa) have cumulatively reported more than 20,000 suspected cases, of which 9,864 were laboratory-confirmed and 1,252 died. Most patients are children and adolescents. Insufficient diagnostic reagents, testing and clinical care capacity, and shortages of diphtheria antitoxin (DAT) are seriously hindering outbreak prevention and control. WHO considers that the outbreak in the African Region may continue to spread, and assesses the overall public health risk in the African Region as high. Most countries outside the African Region have well-established immunization programmes and sound surveillance systems, so the global public health risk is low.

EsEkut9DI1yuKOwkDJFmGg.zh: 查德自7月截至9/6累計報告1,631例病例,其中113例死亡(CFR: 7%),病患以女性為多,年齡多介於5-14歲及15-44歲,主要集中於東部瓦達伊省(Ouaddai)難民營,該難民營收容2萬名來自蘇丹之難民;經實驗鑑定此波疫情為小川型弧菌(O1 Ogawa)引起,已接種110萬劑疫苗,將加強相關防治措施。非洲自2025年迄今,已有23個國家通報239,754例個案,5,274例死亡。
EsEkut9DI1yuKOwkDJFmGg.en: From July to 6 September, Chad cumulatively reported 1,631 cases, including 113 deaths (CFR: 7%). Patients are mostly female, and most are aged 5–14 and 15–44 years. Cases are concentrated in refugee camps in Ouaddai Province in the east, which house 20,000 refugees from Sudan. Laboratory testing identified the outbreak as caused by Vibrio cholerae O1 Ogawa. 1.1 million doses of vaccine have been administered, and control measures will be strengthened. Since the start of 2025, 23 African countries have reported 239,754 cases and 5,274 deaths.

For environmental samples, WPV1 increased by four samples in Afghanistan, cVDPV1 by six samples in Israel, and cVDPV2 by eight samples in Germany.

y5vo0EStjCnD6Bi4awqzJQ.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於7/10-16期間,cVDPV2新增3國共9例,分別為葉門7例、查德/奈及利亞各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦41件,cVDPV2新增2國共7件,分別為巴布亞紐幾內亞6件、蘇丹1件。

For environmental samples, WPV1 increased by 41 in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 increased by 7 in 2 countries: 6 in Papua New Guinea and 1 in Sudan.

kY4peGDHORIBotL0ZEMU2w.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於4/1-5/7期間, cVDPV2型新增查德1例,cVDPV3新增幾內亞1例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增阿富汗7件,cVDPV2陽性樣本新增3國共3件,分別為喀麥隆、中非共和國、吉布地各1件。

For environmental samples, WPV1-positive samples increased by 7 in Afghanistan, and cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 3 across 3 countries: 1 each in Cameroon, the Central African Republic and Djibouti.

XlLiIIzetGjlsxJbTvpHEg.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於3/27-4/2期間,cVDPV2型新增查德2例病例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦19件;cVDPV2型陽性樣本新增4國共6件,分別為奈及利亞/阿爾及利亞各2件、查德/塞內加爾各1件。

For environmental samples, WPV1-positive samples increased by 19 in Pakistan. cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 6 across 4 countries: 2 each in Nigeria and Algeria, and 1 each in Chad and Senegal.

CA9elNAIcTMjDeXj9nGhqw.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於3/13-19期間,新增報告cVDPV2型新增3國共6例病例,分別為索馬利亞4例、安哥拉/奈及利亞各1例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦12件;cVDPV2型陽性樣本新增7國共13件,分別為葉門5件、吉布地3件、安哥拉/查德/象牙海岸/衣索比亞/索馬利亞各1件。
CA9elNAIcTMjDeXj9nGhqw.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 13 and 19 March, 6 new cVDPV2 cases were reported in 3 countries: 4 in Somalia, and 1 each in Angola and Nigeria. For environmental samples, 12 new WPV1-positive samples were reported in Pakistan. 13 new cVDPV2-positive samples were reported in 7 countries: 5 in Yemen, 3 in Djibouti, and 1 each in Angola, Chad, Côte d'Ivoire, Ethiopia and Somalia.

jM1M99mu0rPd06_9N3QXWg.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於3/6-12期間,新增報告cVDPV2型新增3國共7例病例,分別為查德/奈及利亞各3例、剛果民主共和國1例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦18件;cVDPV2型陽性樣本新增3國共8件,分別為查德/巴勒斯坦各3件、坦尚亞2件。
jM1M99mu0rPd06_9N3QXWg.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 6 and 12 March, 7 new cVDPV2 cases were reported in 3 countries: 3 each in Chad and Nigeria, and 1 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. For environmental samples, 18 new WPV1-positive samples were reported in Pakistan. 8 new cVDPV2-positive samples were reported in 3 countries: 3 each in Chad and Palestine, and 2 in Tanzania.

P_G83niooL3PfKouUpGBaA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於2/20-26期間,新增報告WPV1型巴基斯坦1例病例;cVDPV2型新增3國13例病例,分別為查德6例、衣索比亞5例、葉門2例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦13件;cVDPV2型陽性樣本新增6國10件,分別為德國4件、吉布地2件、查德/象牙海岸/波蘭/英國各1件。
P_G83niooL3PfKouUpGBaA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 20 and 26 February, one new WPV1 case was reported in Pakistan. 13 new cVDPV2 cases were reported in 3 countries: 6 in Chad, 5 in Ethiopia and 2 in Yemen. For environmental samples, 13 new WPV1-positive samples were reported in Pakistan. 10 new cVDPV2-positive samples were reported in 6 countries: 4 in Germany, 2 in Djibouti, and 1 each in Chad, Côte d'Ivoire, Poland and the United Kingdom.

Tfp8jXIUwygwJAzjBVhQFQ.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於1/9-1/15期間,巴基斯坦報告新增2例WPV1型病例;共3國新增11例cVDPV2型病例,分別為衣索比亞7例、查德3例、奈及利亞1例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增17件WPV1型陽性樣本;德國新增11件cVDPV2型陽性樣本。
Tfp8jXIUwygwJAzjBVhQFQ.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 9–15 January, Pakistan reported two new WPV1 cases. Three countries reported 11 new cVDPV2 cases in total: Ethiopia 7, Chad 3 and Nigeria 1. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported 17 new WPV1-positive samples, and Germany reported 11 new cVDPV2-positive samples.

F5sIzm5Rr4eGoqfgVv6TEA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 12/12-12/18期間,巴基斯坦新增4例WPV1病例;共2國新增7例cVDPV2,分別為查德4例、奈及利亞3例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增8件WPV1陽性樣本;共8國新增23件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為德國7件、英國5件、奈及利亞/南蘇丹各3 件、查德2件、喀麥隆/象牙海岸/芬蘭各1件。 澳洲墨爾本於汙水中檢出VDPV2陽性樣本,經檢測可能與海外接種小兒麻痺活性疫苗人員相關,並於維多利亞州境內持續散播,當局表示當地疫苗接種率高且汙水經有效處理,評估傳播風險為低。
F5sIzm5Rr4eGoqfgVv6TEA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 12–18 December, Pakistan reported four new WPV1 cases. Two countries reported seven new cVDPV2 cases: four in Chad and three in Nigeria. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported eight new WPV1-positive samples. Eight countries reported 23 new cVDPV2-positive samples: seven in Germany, five in the United Kingdom, three each in Nigeria and South Sudan, two in Chad, and one each in Cameroon, Côte d'Ivoire and Finland. In Australia, VDPV2-positive samples were detected in wastewater in Melbourne. Testing suggests they may be linked to personnel who received live oral polio vaccine overseas, and the virus continues to spread within Victoria State. Authorities state that vaccination coverage in the area is high and wastewater is effectively treated, and they assess the transmission risk as low.

Ry_nHw8QL-LR7aLPoygsHQ.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 12/5-12/11期間,巴基斯坦新增3例WPV1病例;共2國新增7例cVDPV2,分別為奈及利亞5例、查德2例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增15件WPV1陽性樣本;共5國新增11件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為巴勒斯坦6件、吉布地2件、阿爾及利亞/象牙海岸/日各1件。 歐洲更新cVDPV2陽性樣本資訊,英國於12/10發布於倫敦、南部及中部地區檢出4件陽性樣本,德國新增6件陽性樣本,所有樣本皆於11月採集;歐洲迄今累計5國檢出cVDPV2陽性樣本,經檢驗該地區樣本皆與奈及利亞贊法拉州(Zamfara)病毒株相關,ECDC表示病毒可能由流行地區多次移入或一次移入後於歐洲社區傳播。
Ry_nHw8QL-LR7aLPoygsHQ.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 5–11 December, Pakistan reported three new WPV1 cases. Two countries reported seven new cVDPV2 cases: five in Nigeria and two in Chad. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported 15 new WPV1-positive samples. Five countries reported 11 new cVDPV2-positive samples: six in Palestine, two in Djibouti, and one each in Algeria, Côte d'Ivoire and Niger. Europe has updated its cVDPV2-positive sample information: the United Kingdom reported on 10 December that four positive samples had been detected in London and in the southern and central regions, and Germany reported six new positive samples; all samples were collected in November. So far, five European countries have detected cVDPV2-positive samples. Testing shows that the samples in this region are all related to the virus strain from Zamfara State, Nigeria. ECDC says the virus may have been introduced to Europe through repeated introductions from endemic areas, or through a single introduction followed by community spread.

38KIHrf_aTeVI-3q2saAzQ.zh: 非洲今年截至11/22累計報告23,040例病例,其中11,114例確診,588例死亡(CFR:5.26%),以奈及利亞報告16,747例(461例死亡)最為嚴峻,另有幾內亞報告2,869例、查德2,625例、日746例、茅利塔亞及加彭各數十例亦正處流行期,其中,查德近期疫情明顯上升;非洲區去年報告2.7萬例病例。 越南北部高平省11月新增1例死亡病例,病患為11歲女孩,於11月中旬出現咳嗽及發燒症狀,一週後死亡,當局已進行接觸者隔離及校園消毒。
38KIHrf_aTeVI-3q2saAzQ.en: Africa reported 23,040 cases cumulatively this year as of 22 November, including 11,114 confirmed and 588 deaths (CFR 5.26%). Nigeria has the most severe situation, with 16,747 cases (461 deaths). Guinea reported 2,869 cases, Chad 2,625 and Niger 746, while Mauritania and Gabon each reported several dozen cases; all are in epidemic periods. Chad's recent outbreak has risen markedly. The African Region reported 27,000 cases last year. Viet Nam: In November, Cao Bằng Province in northern Viet Nam reported one new death, an 11-year-old girl who developed cough and fever in mid-November and died a week later. Authorities have quarantined contacts and disinfected the school.

NdTbNjqsO2mpAriVJxOaMw.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 11/14-11/20期間,巴基斯坦新增1例WPV1病例;共2國新增6例cVDPV2病例,其中查德5例、奈及利亞1例。環境樣本部分,共2國新增7件WPV1陽性樣本,分別為阿富汗6件、巴基斯坦1件;共3國新增3件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為查德/波蘭/南蘇丹各1件。 波蘭於11/18報告該國檢出cVDPV2陽性樣本,係自該國首都華沙10/22之廢水樣本中檢出,當地迄無報告病例。經分析顯示,該病毒與奈及利亞北部疫情相關,近期亦於西班牙被檢測到。
NdTbNjqsO2mpAriVJxOaMw.en:
The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 14 and 20 November, Pakistan added 1 WPV1 case. A total of 2 countries added 6 cVDPV2 cases: Chad 5 and Nigeria 1. For environmental samples, 2 countries added 7 WPV1-positive samples: Afghanistan 6 and Pakistan 1. A total of 3 countries added 3 cVDPV2-positive samples: Chad, Poland and South Sudan, 1 each.

Poland reported on 18 November that cVDPV2-positive samples had been detected in the country, from wastewater samples collected in the capital, Warsaw, on 22 October. No cases have been reported locally. Analysis shows that the virus is related to the outbreak in northern Nigeria, and it has also recently been detected in Spain.

_a2LG9aPvfpGyxIexkufmQ.zh: 越南胡志明市疫情持續上升,單週新增病例數突破200例,今年截至11/22累計報告逾1,800例,其中3例死亡,當局已加強疫苗接種措施。 吉爾吉斯今年截至9月累計報告13,358例病例,疫情於6月達高峰後持續下降,目前已趨緩,病例多分布於北部及西南部州別,當局已加強疫苗接種。 非洲疫情持續,今年截至11/8累計報告23萬2,363例病例,其中21,214例確診,3,136例死亡(CFR:1.35%),以剛果民主共和國報告9.2萬餘例最為嚴峻、另有衣索比亞、蒲隆地、摩洛哥、索馬利亞、奈及利亞及布吉納法索報告1至2.8萬餘例,查德及象牙海岸報告7千至8千餘例,21國報告數十至5千例不等。
_a2LG9aPvfpGyxIexkufmQ.en:
Viet Nam: In Ho Chi Minh City, the outbreak continues to rise, with weekly new cases exceeding 200. As of 22 November this year, more than 1,800 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 3 deaths, and authorities have stepped up vaccination measures.

Kyrgyzstan: As of September this year, 13,358 cases have been cumulatively reported. The outbreak peaked in June and has declined since, and is now slowing. Cases are mainly distributed in the northern and south-western regions, and authorities have stepped up vaccination.

Africa: The outbreak continues. As of 8 November this year, 232,363 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 21,214 confirmed cases and 3,136 deaths (CFR: 1.35%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo has been most severely affected, reporting more than 92,000 cases. Ethiopia, Burundi, Morocco, Somalia, Nigeria and Burkina Faso each reported between 1 and more than 28,000 cases; Chad and Côte d'Ivoire reported 7,000 to more than 8,000 cases; and 21 countries reported from several dozen to 5,000 cases.

PfrYpGBs8I0tFmxnL3y0aA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 11/7-11/13期間,巴基斯坦新增3例WPV1病例;共2國新增9例cVDPV2病例,其中奈及利亞7例、查德2例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增19件WPV1陽性樣本;共2國新增2件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為日/塞內加爾各1件。
PfrYpGBs8I0tFmxnL3y0aA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 7 and 13 November, Pakistan added 3 WPV1 cases. A total of 2 countries added 9 cVDPV2 cases: Nigeria 7 and Chad 2. For environmental samples, Pakistan added 19 WPV1-positive samples. A total of 2 countries added 2 cVDPV2-positive samples, one each in Niger and Senegal.

yfYSgiBBBmPA7Ey6MbHpyA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 10/24-10/30期間,巴基斯坦新增2例WPV1病例;查德新增2例cVDPV2病例;幾內亞新增3例cVDPV3病例。環境樣本部分,阿富汗新增1件WPV1陽性樣本;共4國新增4件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為喀麥隆/幾內亞/日/塞內加爾各1件。 西班牙於10/3報告該國首件cVDPV2陽性樣本,該樣本於9月中旬自該國東北部加泰隆亞廢水樣本中檢出,當地迄無報告病例,當地疫苗覆蓋率逾92%,評估對公眾健康影響有限。 法屬圭亞那於10/14首次檢出cVDPV3陽性樣本,樣本採集自首府開雲(Cayenne),目前尚無報告病例。
yfYSgiBBBmPA7Ey6MbHpyA.en:
The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 24 and 30 October, Pakistan added 2 WPV1 cases, Chad added 2 cVDPV2 cases and Guinea added 3 cVDPV3 cases. For environmental samples, Afghanistan added 1 WPV1-positive sample; a total of 4 countries added 4 cVDPV2-positive samples, one each in Cameroon, Guinea, Niger and Senegal.

Spain reported on 3 October its first cVDPV2-positive sample, detected in mid-September in wastewater from Catalonia in northeastern Spain. No cases have been reported locally, local vaccination coverage exceeds 92%, and the impact on public health is assessed as limited.

French Guiana detected its first cVDPV3-positive sample on 14 October. The sample was collected in the capital, Cayenne. No cases have been reported so far.

LetmbIJE6lrOylghYlpDKg.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於10/17-10/23期間,共2國新增8例WPV1病例,分別為巴基斯坦7例、阿富汗1例;共3國新增9例cVDPV2病例,分別為奈及利亞5例、查德3例、日1例。環境樣本部分,共2國新增11件WPV1陽性樣本,分別為阿富汗10件、巴基斯坦1件;共3國新增4件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為查德2件、吉布地/日各1件。
LetmbIJE6lrOylghYlpDKg.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 17 and 23 October, a total of 2 countries added 8 WPV1 cases: Pakistan 7 and Afghanistan 1. A total of 3 countries added 9 cVDPV2 cases: Nigeria 5, Chad 3 and Niger 1. For environmental samples, 2 countries added 11 WPV1-positive samples: Afghanistan 10 and Pakistan 1. A total of 3 countries added 4 cVDPV2-positive samples: Chad 2, and Djibouti and Niger 1 each.

X217ZeJzLS3fNRwjRQXYmQ.zh: 非洲今年截至10/11累計報告19,130例病例,其中9,816例確診,494例死亡(CFR:5.0%),以奈及利亞報告14,195例(397例死亡)最為嚴峻,另有幾內亞報告2,869例、查德1,307例、日746例及加彭13例亦正流行中;該地區去年報告2.7萬例病例,CFR:5.7%。
X217ZeJzLS3fNRwjRQXYmQ.en: Africa has cumulatively reported 19,130 cases so far this year as of 11 October, including 9,816 confirmed cases and 494 deaths (CFR: 5.0%). Nigeria is the most severely affected, with 14,195 cases (397 deaths). Guinea reported 2,869 cases, Chad 1,307, Niger 746 and Gabon 13, and these outbreaks are also ongoing. Last year the region reported 27,000 cases, with a CFR of 5.7%.

Mi7mhyVVSmRwhe_K3pD3jQ.zh: 非洲疫情持續,今年截至9/26累計報告21萬8,258例病例,其中19,454例確診,2,968例死亡(CFR:1.25%),以剛果民主共和國8.5萬餘例、衣索比亞2.7萬餘例最多,另有蒲隆地、摩洛哥、奈及利亞、布吉納法索及索馬利亞報告1萬餘例,查德及象牙海岸報告7千至8千餘例,19國報告數十至5千例不等。 越南南部胡志明市疫情上升,9月底單週新增近百例病例,自疫情爆發(時間不明)截至9/26累計報告達743例,多為5歲以下兒童,當局表示該市之免疫覆蓋率於各地區差異大,目前已超過72%;另報載該國中、北部省份疫情亦在上升。
Mi7mhyVVSmRwhe_K3pD3jQ.en: The outbreak in Africa continues. As of 26 September this year, 218,258 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 19,454 were confirmed and 2,968 died (CFR: 1.25%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo (over 85,000) and Ethiopia (over 27,000) account for the most cases. Burundi, Morocco, Nigeria, Burkina Faso and Somalia each reported over 10,000 cases, Chad and Côte d'Ivoire reported 7,000 to 8,000 cases, and 19 countries reported between several dozen and 5,000 cases. In southern Viet Nam, cases in Ho Chi Minh City have risen. Nearly 100 new cases were reported in the last week of September, and since the outbreak began (date unspecified), 743 cases have been reported cumulatively as of 26 September, mostly children under 5. Authorities say immunization coverage differs widely across districts in the city and currently exceeds 72%. Media reports also indicate that cases are rising in central and northern provinces of the country.
